headline: 93 killed on Aug 4 as ‘March to Dhaka’ moved up to Aug 5
summary: The decision to advance the mass protest date became a turning point, leading to the widespread clashes and the eventual fall of the Sheikh Hasina government.
details: On August 4, 2024, the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement decided to move the 'March to Dhaka' program forward by one day, from August 6 to August 5. This strategic shift became a critical turning point in the mass uprising.
caption:
93 people were killed on August 4 alone as the student-led movement advanced their 'March to Dhaka' deadline.

On August 4, 2024, the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement decided to move the 'March to Dhaka' program forward by one day, from August 6 to August 5. This strategic shift became a critical turning point in the mass uprising.

headline: Rail link between Dhaka and northern Bangladesh snapped after derailment
summary: A coach of the Silk City Express derailed near Sirajganj, suspending all train movement between the capital and the north.
details: Train services between Dhaka and northern Bangladesh were suspended this morning after a coach of the Dhaka-bound Silk City Express derailed near Shaheed M Mansur Ali Railway Station in Sirajganj.
The incident occurred around 10:55 am as the Rajshahi-origin intercity train was passing through the station, according to Md Moniruzzaman, station master of Jamuna Bridge West Railway Station.

One coach left the tracks between Shaheed M Mansur Ali Railway Station and Jamuna Bridge West Railway Station. The train stopped immediately after the emergency brake chain was pulled, preventing any casualties.
The derailment has suspended all train movement between Dhaka and the north. Services to the south-west are also affected as there is no alternative railway route across the Jamuna Rail Bridge.
The Nilphamari-bound Nil Sagar Express and two other northbound trains were stranded at various stations, causing significant inconvenience to commuters.
Railway authorities have dispatched relief crews and a rescue train to the site to clear the tracks and restore services.
caption:
A derailed Silk City Express coach has snapped the rail link between Dhaka and northern Bangladesh.

Train services between Dhaka and northern Bangladesh were suspended this morning after a coach of the Dhaka-bound Silk City Express derailed near Shaheed M Mansur Ali Railway Station in Sirajganj.

The incident occurred around 10:55 am as the Rajshahi-origin intercity train was passing through the station, according to Md Moniruzzaman, station master of Jamuna Bridge West Railway Station.

One coach left the tracks between Shaheed M Mansur Ali Railway Station and Jamuna Bridge West Railway Station. The train stopped immediately after the emergency brake chain was pulled, preventing any casualties.

The derailment has suspended all train movement between Dhaka and the north. Services to the south-west are also affected as there is no alternative railway route across the Jamuna Rail Bridge.

The Nilphamari-bound Nil Sagar Express and two other northbound trains were stranded at various stations, causing significant inconvenience to commuters.

Railway authorities have dispatched relief crews and a rescue train to the site to clear the tracks and restore services.

#Bangladesh #Railway #Sirajganj #TravelAlert #BreakingNews

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
